{{Top|leg}}
'''4-DOF robot arm''' was a style of robotic arm designed and produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], commonly used on the [[WED-15 Septoid Treadwell/Legends|WED-15 Septoid Treadwell]] droids. It consisted of two tubing segments connected with servos and hydraulics, and was equipped with a universal mount, which allowed to attach it to any given type of robotic hand or tool. Standard WED Treadwell droids were mounted with four of those arms.
